about: IR Capture's VU meter (design/render/ircapture_vu.py, the Tools studio; ircapture_vu_post.py). Pixels of the 1x files; the app scales by its width over outline[2]. lit and unlit are the same meter with its lamp on and off (cross-faded as the lamp warms); the needle is turned about needle_pivot, laid on pivot, by the angle table (degrees from vertical by VU), and masked to the window.
